official.title: Seasonal Climate Outlook
official.english_core_text: The rainfall forecast for the JFM season is predicted to be near- to above-normal over most parts of the country, aside from below-normal rainfall conditions over some areas in western Luzon. Central, Quezon City, Metro Manila, Philippines 1100 Website: http://bagong.pagasa.dost.gov.ph Forecast rainfall for this season suggests generally near-normal conditions over most parts of the country, aside from below-normal conditions in some areas of the Ilocos region and the western portions of Central Luzon and CALABARZON. Likewise, the probabilistic forecast indicates a moderate to high chance of above- normal rainfall conditions in most areas of the country. April to June (AMJ) 2026 Outlook Transition from La Niña to ENSO-neutral conditions is anticipated during the season.

official.title: Monthly Climate Assessment and Outlook
official.english_core_text: El Niño increases the likelihood of below-normal rainfall conditions, which may result in adverse impacts such as dry spells and droughts in some areas of the country. Further, based on the said rainfall assessment, ten (10) provinces experienced meteorological drought; twenty-one (21) provinces were under dry spells, and one (1) province experienced dry conditions. Central, Quezon City, Metro Manila, Philippines 1100 Website: http://www.pagasa.dost.gov.ph The rainfall forecast for July shows that above-normal rainfall is expected in the northern and western parts of Luzon, and below-normal rainfall are likely in western and eastern Mindanao, while near-normal conditions are expected across the rest of the country. This is supported by the probabilistic forecast, suggesting higher chances of above-normal rainfall in the northern and western parts of Luzon, while higher chances of below-normal rainfall in most parts of Mindanao.
